description: Address review findings: add anon_id format validation to /chat/history endpoint and add test for invalid anon_id rejection.
steps: Step 1: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, import re and add _ANON_ID_PATTERN (or import from conversations.py) to validate anon_id format (^anon_[a-f0-9]{32}$) before querying MongoDB. If invalid, return empty list (same as no anon_id provided).
Step 2: Add a test to apps/backend/tests/test_anon_access.py that verifies passing an invalid anon_id (e.g., a raw MongoDB ObjectId) to GET /chat/history returns an empty list, not the user's data.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid anon_id (not matching ^anon_[a-f0-9]{32}$) to GET /chat/history returns empty list with 200 status
Invalid anon_id to GET /chat/conversations (legacy alias) also returns empty list
Valid anon_id continues to work as before
New test verifies invalid anon_id returns empty list
All existing tests continue to pass
